description: This file defines an interface for Zend HTTP Client Adapters, specifying methods for configuration, connection management, request writing, response reading, and closing the connection.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Interface
classes.description: Interface for HTTP client adapter classes that connect, send requests, read responses, and manage connections.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration array for the adapter.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the remote server.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends a request to the remote server.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads the response from the server.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection to the server.
